title: Raddle
summary: RAD'DLE, verb transitive To twist; to wind together. [Not in use.] RAD'DLE, noun [supra.] A long stick used in hedging; also, a hedge formed by interweaving the shoots and branches of trees or shrubs.

inlines.v: RAD'DLE, verb transitive To twist; to wind together.
